dedupe_keys.name: taiwan administration for cyber security monthly reports and nccsc threat intelligence sharing statistics for telecom operators

description: The Ministry of Digital Affairs publishes two open datasets on the cyber threat picture in Taiwan. The Administration for Cyber Security's monthly cyber security report dataset, listed since October 2025 and updated monthly (last in September 2026), indexes each monthly report by year and month with a link. The reports cover recent policy points and overall threat trends. The National Communications and Cyber Security Center dataset gives quarterly counts of threat intelligence shared with communications operators: early warning advisories (EWA), web attack intelligence (ANA), intrusion intelligence (INT), defensive alerts (DEF), other and total, in six files from 2023. Related MODA datasets list laboratories accredited to test the security of critical telecom infrastructure equipment and the yearly smartphone pre-installed software tests. Coverage: Taiwan. Format and access: CSV, JSON and XML indexes and tables from the national open data portal, free under the Open Government Data License. Caveats: the monthly dataset is an index of report links, so figures sit in the linked reports, which were not opened; intelligence-sharing counts measure information flow to operators, not incidents; categories follow Taiwan's own scheme. Simulation uses: time series of threat intelligence volumes aimed at the communications sector for cyber resilience scenarios. Related records: the HKCERT security incident statistics, the JPCERT/CC quarterly incident reports and the Singapore Cyber Landscape give comparable regional series.
